additional_info.subject: ID0425191-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2 / S1 313508370046] Temperature Error CRM:00642002301
additional_info.body:
Hello Matteo,
Hope you are doing great.
As per the issue you reported regarding a temperature sensor error, we have investigated and found that
DC1
is affected.
As per your reported issue kindly let us know if you had hard rebooted the charger to fix this issue. & kindly provide us the voltage between CP and ground, if it is different from constant 12 V.
Kindly confirm if you are getting these errors at present in the chargers. Our findings are that these errors occurred due to ambient temperature which is out of charger's operating range.
If above condition is normal, then we will recommend you the following steps to be followed-
1. Check resistance between P1 and P2, N1 and N2 in below attached image, and check at the XD10.
2. Connectivity between P2 & N2.
3. Interchange the wiring of DC1 & DC2 cable to check from where the issue is generating.
Temp Vs Resistance Table-->
If it is possible please carry a resistor along with you as per temp mentioned in above table so that we can check the KF13 also.
